summary: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) of shareholders to be held July 6, 2026. The EGM proposes a special resolution to reduce and reorganize authorized share capital from US$35.2 trillion divided into 100 trillion Class A and 10 trillion Class B shares at US$0.32 par value each, to US$11,000 divided into unspecified shares. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine capital reorganization proposal; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
